coverage_contract.c8_outgoing: Run the complete root and target-local terminal policy first. On MISS, apply the double-low predicate to the canonical first actual eligible raw occurrence under a fixed path order. Boolean excluded middle gives TERMINAL, DOUBLE_LOW or OTHER; it does not construct the OTHER successor.
coverage_contract.atomic_target: For each canonical target chart, recompute the centered bounded hit set first; on no hit, test whether -1 lies in the support subgroup. This gives exactly hit, F or G. The labels alone do not prove persistent re-entry.
